cover.styleNotes: Match the covers already on the site in public/images/blog: a soft 3D render on a plain pale blue to white gradient, one clear central object, matte rounded surfaces, even studio lighting, a soft shadow underneath. Palette is brand blue #2f7cf0, light blue #8ebdff, ink navy #16283a for small details and CTA orange #f97316 as a small accent only. No photography, no people, no text or numbers in the image, no logos, no realistic product UI, no readable charts. The object must say what the article is about at a glance. Describe the intended cover in the cover_brief frontmatter field first.
